ios.desc:
Know what to do next—for your workouts, your nutrition, and your goals.

Daily Burn combines personalized fitness and nutrition coaching with 2,000+ on-demand workouts. Follow a plan built around your life, get detailed guidance from a real human coach, and keep moving without relying on a gym.

GET A PLAN BUILT AROUND YOU

Tell us your goals, fitness level, workout preferences, schedule, and nutrition needs. Daily Burn Coaching uses them to shape a personalized approach that makes your next step clearer.

WORK WITH A REAL HUMAN COACH

Get fitness guidance, nutrition coaching, support, and accountability inside the app. Ask questions, share progress, and send text, audio, photos, or video as you work toward your goals.

GET PERSONALIZED NUTRITION GUIDANCE

Your plan goes beyond workouts. Get detailed nutrition coaching tailored to your goals, preferences, and daily routine. Your coach can help you make practical choices, adjust your approach, and stay accountable without relying on generic advice.

FIND A WORKOUT THAT FITS TODAY

Choose from 2,000+ audio and video workouts across:

- Strength and dumbbell training
- Cardio and HIIT
- Yoga and Pilates
- Mobility and stretching
- Meditation
- Dance
- Postnatal fitness
- And more

Whether you have 10 minutes or a full hour, there’s a workout that can fit your day.

TRAIN WITH EXPERT INSTRUCTORS

Follow clear, motivating instruction from experienced trainers. Explore workout programs, find modifications, and choose sessions that match your time, equipment, and fitness level.

BUILD A ROUTINE WITHOUT THE BOREDOM

Follow your plan when you want structure, or explore the library when you want something different. Save favorites, track completed workouts, and keep your routine moving forward.

WORK OUT WHERE YOU ARE

Access Daily Burn on iPhone, iPad, desktop, or laptop. You can also bring workouts to a compatible TV using supported streaming devices or AirPlay.

Daily Burn gives you more than a workout library. It gives you personalized fitness and nutrition guidance, more ways to move, and a real coach to help you stay consistent.

Download Daily Burn and build a routine around your life.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

SEEKING WORK -- Philadelphia, PA

I've successfully worked remotely with companies in NYC, Chicago, and California. Also open to occasional travel.

Hi, I'm Julius!

I'm looking to get started on something new soon. Preferably an iOS app but I do Android, backends/APIs, and integrations, too.

Tech: iOS, Android, Python, Ruby, Obj-C, Swift, JavaScript/TypeScript, React. I have a React Native project I'm working on that's in progress but not yet complete so I can't quite show it off.

Some past work:

- The most recent project I've worked on is https://readycoach.net/ -- it's a web app (in the screenshots of that link, the marketing page itself was done by someone else), but I did the architecture, was 1 of 2 developers on the backend (Django/DRF), and was 1 of 3 developers on the frontend (React)

- I built and continue to maintain the RTMDx 1.5 product: http://www.rutgerscps.org/software.html

- I built the Fitocracy iOS app (Objc-C): https://www.fitocracy.com/

- I built the Apple TV app (Swift) for Daily Burn: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/at-home-workouts-by-daily-burn/id472322122#?platform=appleTV

- I am the developer for Mike Vacanti that builds his mobile apps (iOS & Android, Obj-C & Java): http://www.mikesmacros.com/

- I run the nolibscrime.com website for tracking crime in a neighborhood of Philadelphia: https://nolibscrime.com/

- I built the Charlie App iOS app (Obj-C) (though they have since pivoted and no longer have a mobile product, PH link for posterity): …

SEEKING WORD — Remote, Central NJ (Office in Princeton)

My site is http://juliusparishy.com/ and my email address is hello@juliusparishy.com

To get straight to the point, I'm an expert iOS developer with skills across many other platforms too; I've created APIs in Python (Django, Flask) or Ruby (Rails, Sinatra), I've created web apps and desktop apps, and many mobile applications.

In the last year, I've built 3 major apps, Charlie App's iOS app [0], the Daily Burn Apple TV app that was featured by Apple both on the App Store and in Apple Retail Stores [1], and the On The Regimen Macros Tracking app [2]. In the past, I worked for Fitocracy and built both of their iOS apps [3].

I've very good at what I do and I can use my experience to propel your project forward. All you have to do is get in touch to get the ball rolling. I currently have availability for one new project and I'm excited to work on something cool.

You can check out my GitHub (https://github.com/jparishy) and Twitter feed (https://twitter.com/jparishy) to get a feel for the types of things I work on and the kind of person I am. Descriptions of my larger projects and some articles I've written about iOS development can be found on my website. Also check out RunSwift and TestAPNS to see some free dev tools I've created [4].

Looking forward to hearing from you.
